$comment: An expense or a settlement in a group. Unlike the 'without functions' example, there is no members copy: every read goes through the list_expenses function, which checks the caller's CURRENT group membership instead of a stale snapshot (see the docs page comparing the two examples).

kind.description: settlement: paid_by paid the one person in split_between back.

amount.description: In cents of the group's currency.

status.description: Only settlements have one: pending until the receiver confirms it with confirm_settlement. Expenses have no status.
